title: Correct voltage calculation
description: Essential: Student must correctly apply Ohm's Law (V = IR) to obtain 400 V.

title: Correct heat calculation
description: Essential: Student must correctly apply Joule's Law (Q = I²Rt) to obtain 48000 J.

title: Proper time conversion
description: Important: Student must convert 1 minute to 60 seconds before using it in the Joule's Law formula.

title: Correct unit usage
description: Optional: Student includes proper units (V and J) with their final numerical answers.

title: Incorrect time unit
description: Pitfall: Student uses 1 minute directly in the formula without converting to seconds, leading to an incorrect heat value.

title: Wrong power formula
description: Pitfall: Student uses P = IV or P = V²/R for heat calculation without properly accounting for time, or confuses energy with power.
